the HTS-FB coils have potential for the SMES application, and the HTS-FBs can be manufactured with the optimized winding trajectory.

the critical current of REBCO FBCs could be maintained above 100 A at 4.2 K and 10 T, even though the complex bending strain applied to the REBCO tapes during winding process and the winding configuration of the FBC.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the FBC using REBCCO tapes is a promising candidate for a SMES system, and that the critical current property is strongly dependent on the mechanical strain distribution of the HTS coil.
the critical current of REBCO tape can be preserved during the winding process by using the optimized winding machine.
the HTS-FB coil is one of the most promising candidates of SMES coil, and the critical current degradation can be suppressed by the optimization of the winding process and the winding configuration.
